title: Upload failure reflects arbitrary server response bodies into logs and thrown errors
reproduction: Call the real uploadFile route consumer with a controlled non-2xx response containing a unique synthetic secret marker.
Capture its logger arguments and thrown error; verify the marker is absent from both while failure status and a safe remedy remain.
